<!--
  The culture of a company: a strip of three pictures, the heading, a few figures and the values. Axes: layout
  (split: the pictures beside the text, stacked: the pictures under it), tone, density.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Stat } from "./stats-band.types";
  import type { Feature } from "./feature-grid.types";

  export type AboutCompanyProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    lead?: string;
    stats: Stat[];
    values: Feature[];
    layout?: "split" | "stacked";
    tone?: "default" | "muted";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import LucideIcon from "../primitives/lucide-icon/lucide-icon.svelte";
  import Stack from "../primitives/stack/stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.svelte";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    lead = "",
    stats,
    values,
    layout = "split",
    tone = "default",
    density = "default",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: AboutCompanyProps = $props();
</script>

<SectionFrame
  id={id}
  title={title}
  lead={lead}
  tone={tone}
  density={density}
  layout={(((layout as string) === "split") ? "split" : "stack")}
  media={{ show: true, side: "start" }}
  landmarkLabel={landmarkLabel}
>
  <Grid cols="2-4" class="gap-4" data-testid="stats">
    {#each stats as s (s.id)}
      <Stack gap="0" data-testid="stat">
        <Text size="3xl" weight="bold">
          {s.value}
        </Text>
        <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {s.label}
        </Text>
      </Stack>
    {/each}
  </Grid>
  <Box
    class={cn("grid grid-cols-1 gap-4", (((layout as string) === "stacked") ? "md:grid-cols-3" : ""))}
    data-testid="values"
  >
    {#each values as v (v.id)}
      <Group gap="4" align="start" class="border-t border-border pt-4" data-testid="value">
        <LucideIcon name={v.icon} size={20} />
        <Stack gap="2">
          <Text size="sm" weight="semibold">
            {v.title}
          </Text>
          <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
            {v.text}
          </Text>
        </Stack>
      </Group>
    {/each}
  </Box>
  {#snippet aside()}
    <Box class="grid grid-cols-3 gap-4" data-testid="strip">
      <MediaFrame alt={title} ratio="3/4" />
      <MediaFrame alt={title} ratio="3/4" class="mt-8" />
      <MediaFrame alt={title} ratio="3/4" />
    </Box>
  {/snippet}
</SectionFrame>
